seo.title: About Oraixen: Custom Software for Growing Businesses
seo.description: Oraixen builds custom business systems, web and mobile products, e-commerce, AI, and connected software for growing businesses. Software delivery since 2019; Oraixen founded in 2025.

hero.title: Software built around how your business works.
hero.subtitle: We help growing businesses turn operational problems and product ideas into reliable custom software.

story.title: How Oraixen came to be
story.intro: Oraixen works across six service groups: custom business systems, web platforms and e-commerce, mobile applications, AI solutions and automation, hardware and software systems, and system modernization and integrations, for growing businesses and established companies with real operational or product needs.
story.history: Software delivery began in 2019 through an independent team working closely with early clients. In 2025, Oraixen was founded under its current name: the same team and standards, now under one company.

p1.ora: Understand the business before we build
p1.after: : We start with your operations, users, workflows, and constraints, not a list of technologies.

p2.after: : Written scope, realistic timelines, and weekly reviews keep the project visible throughout delivery.

p3.after: : Every release includes a post-launch support window, with documentation and maintenance options for what comes next.

story.closing: We build across e-commerce, food and restaurants, B2B operations, booking, education, and productivity, with clear communication, realistic timelines, and support that continues after delivery.
story.tagline: Build the future. Build with Oraixen.
story.imageAlt: Illustrative image of a team planning a software project
